subject: Whistic + DocuSign: bulk attestation signing workflow and presign integration
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Turner <security@acmepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Whistic + DocuSign: bulk attestation signing workflow and presign integration

Claire —

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. Per our conversation, AcmePay wants a streamlined way to get signed SOC 2 attestation PDFs into Whistic without manual downloads/uploads from our side. We proposed an automated handshake: we produce presigned upload entries (S3 presign) and a DocuSign bulk signing envelope to capture the exec signature. The high-level plan below — can you confirm stakeholders and a short runway target (we suggested 10 business days if procurement approves)?

Plan (high level):
- Redwood: generate presigned POSTs for whitelisted file keys and rotate tokens per upload window.
- DocuSign: Redwood will create a bulk envelope (one envelope, multiple recipients) and provide a webhook URL for status updates.
- Whistic: accept the presigned uploads and map files to the profile's "Evidence" section via API (we provide manifest CSV).
- AcmePay: provide final signer emails and confirm whether they prefer embedded signing or standard DocuSign flow.

Open asks for AcmePay:
1) Final list of signers + emails.
2) Any required naming convention for Evidence fields in Whistic.
3) Legal ok on Redwood generating presigned S3 keys pointing to a Whistic intake bucket.

Attachments: SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf (pdf) — draft attestation for signing.

Next steps: I'll await Claire's confirmation and then schedule a short technical kickoff with Marissa and Rishi.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
From: Claire Turner <security@acmepay.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic + DocuSign: bulk attestation signing workflow and presign integration

Jordan —

This sounds promising. Confirming stakeholders: legal (me, claire@acmepay.com), procurement (procurement@acmepay.com), and compliance ops (ops@acmepay.com). Ten business days is aggressive but workable if we scope it to 1) attestation doc, 2) presign mechanics, 3) webhook for status.

We prefer embedded signing for execs (keeps flow in AcmePay's admin console). Naming convention: prefix with "ACME_REDWOOD_SOC2_YYYYMMDD_<env>". Legal is fine with presigned uploads to Whistic as long as objects are ephemeral (<72 hours) and access is limited to the Whistic intake service account.

I'll loop in procurement separately for contract/DocuSign billing questions.

-Claire

Jordan / Rishi —

Quick technical notes from my side:
- Presign TTL: we'll cap to 48 hours by default; can change to 72 if legal insists.
- Manifest format for Whistic: attached CSV sample (we'll generate programmatically). Fields: filename, s3_key, presign_expiry, profile_id, evidence_field.
- DocuSign: we can use template ID 0a1b2c for the attestation and dispatch a bulk envelope. We need a webhook URL from AcmePay for event notifications; if they want embedded, we'll generate clientUserId per recipient and return the redirect URL via our provisioning API.

I included Soojin to coordinate the Whistic API mapping and ensure we don't overwrite existing evidence entries.

Let's kickoff a 30-minute tech call tomorrow — is 11am PT ok for AcmePay?

Marissa
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: whistic_presign_instructions.csv (csv)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Claire Turner <security@acmepay.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic + DocuSign: bulk attestation signing workflow and presign integration

Claire,

11am PT tomorrow works for the tech call. Quick checklist I'm tracking before we go live:
- [ ] Signed SOW amendment for DocuSign usage (procurement)
- [ ] Whistic intake API keys scoped to intake bucket only
- [ ] Webhook endpoint & public cert for DocuSign callbacks
- [ ] Presign rotation policy (default 48h) documented
- [ ] Test envelope with one internal signer and one external signer (Acme test account)

I'll own the test envelope and will share the test results in this thread. If procurement prefers non-embedded signing, confirm and we'll switch to standard DocuSign immediate send.

Thanks,
Rishi
